basis: FD4 preflight v1 assumption of at most two visible tail tuples was contradicted by the source stream, which contains as many as six future tail fragments while only two holds are active.
claim_boundary: Read-only replay of frozen FD-1 frames through current-frame crop/invert adapter and TTC estimator; no neural chart run, game, score, or training.

engineering_assumptions.coordinate: Raw FD-1 normalized_position is (strike_line_y - head_y)/playfield_height: 0 at strike line and 1 at top. Crop heads outside [0,1] and transform valid heads to progress=1-raw_position.
engineering_assumptions.hold_identity: FD-1 has no note IDs or explicit head kind. A same-lane current tail marks a head as hold.
engineering_assumptions.tail_fragments: Up to six future tail fragments can appear, including multiple in one lane. Keep the closest current tail (smallest raw position) per lane; clamp a tail at/past the strike line to zero.
engineering_assumptions.capacity: At most 14 current heads, six raw tail fragments, and four lane-reduced tail positions, matching the scanned FD-1 source.

predeclared_checks: frame bounds respect scanned FD-1 maxima after per-lane reduction
valid head progress increases toward strike
TTC output is finite and in [0,1]
no chart labels or schedule enter encoder
